WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM lead_crm.outbox_jobs
    WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND available_at <= NOW()
    ORDER BY available_at, created_at
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.outbox_jobs AS job
    SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
    FROM candidate
    WHERE job.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING job.*
)
SELECT * FROM claimed;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.outbox_jobs
    SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = NOW(), locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL, external_reference = $2, updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'PROCESSING'
    RETURNING *
), audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id, submission_id, event_type, actor_type, event_data
    )
    SELECT lead.correlation_id, lead.id, 'OUTBOX_JOB_SENT', 'WORKFLOW',
           jsonb_build_object('job_id', updated.id, 'job_type', updated.job_type,
                              'attempt_count', updated.attempt_count,
                              'external_reference', updated.external_reference)
    FROM updated JOIN lead_crm.lead_submissions lead ON lead.id = updated.submission_id
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT 'SENT' AS outcome, updated.*, audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM updated LEFT JOIN audit ON true;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.outbox_jobs
    SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN 'DEAD_LETTER' ELSE 'RETRY' END,
        available_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN available_at
                            ELSE NOW() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(3600, (power(2, attempt_count)::integer * 60))) END,
        locked_at = NULL, last_error = $2, updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'PROCESSING'
    RETURNING *
), audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id, submission_id, event_type, actor_type, event_data
    )
    SELECT lead.correlation_id, lead.id,
           CASE WHEN updated.status = 'DEAD_LETTER' THEN 'OUTBOX_JOB_DEAD_LETTERED' ELSE 'OUTBOX_JOB_RETRY_SCHEDULED' END,
           'WORKFLOW',
           jsonb_build_object('job_id', updated.id, 'job_type', updated.job_type,
                              'attempt_count', updated.attempt_count, 'error', updated.last_error,
                              'available_at', updated.available_at)
    FROM updated JOIN lead_crm.lead_submissions lead ON lead.id = updated.submission_id
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT updated.status AS outcome, updated.*, audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM updated LEFT JOIN audit ON true;
